facts.value: Most studies have shown that religious involvement and spirituality are associated with better health outcomes, including greater longevity, coping skills, and health-related quality of life (even during terminal illness) and less anxiety, depression, and suicide.
facts.programme_association: Religious Studies Degree — Bachelor of Arts | ASU Online

facts.value: The influence of religion on health is largely beneficial, based on a review of related literature.
facts.programme_association: Religious Studies Degree — Bachelor of Arts | ASU Online

facts.value: Several studies have discovered positive correlations between religious belief and practice and mental and physical health and longevity.
facts.programme_association: Religious Studies Degree — Bachelor of Arts | ASU Online

facts.value: The role of different dimensions of spirituality/religiosity in health is rather more complicated.
facts.programme_association: Religious Studies Degree — Bachelor of Arts | ASU Online

facts.value: It may not be appropriate to generalize findings about the relationship between spirituality/religiosity and health from one form of spirituality/religiosity to another, across denominations, or to assume effects are uniform for men and women.
